Sunnyside DaycareToy Story 3Daycare toys. Strawberry dessert.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersTortilla head quesadillasFlour tortillas filled with cheddar and Monterey Jack, cut in wedges, fresh salsaHow to make it8 flour tortillas150g cheddar, grated150g Monterey Jack, grated2 tomatoes, diced1 red onion, diced2 tbsp chopped corianderDice the tomatoes with the onion and coriander for salsa.Fill half the tortillas with the cheddar and Monterey Jack, top with the rest and press.Cook in a dry pan until golden and melted, in batches.Cut into wedges.Sunnyside ham and cheese pinwheelsPuff pastry spirals with tomato relish, ham and cheddarHow to make it2 sheets of puff pastry, thawed2 tbsp tomato relish8 slices of leg ham120g cheddar, grated1 egg, beatenHeat the oven to 200°C. Lay the pastry flat and spread with tomato relish.Cover with ham and cheddar and roll up tightly from one edge.Chill the logs for 15 minutes.Cut each log into slices, lay flat on lined trays and brush with beaten egg.Bake for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.MainsAndy's spaghetti and meatballsBeef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce over spaghetti, extra parmesanHow to make it300g beef mince300g pork mince80g parmesan, grated2 tbsp chopped parsley2 tins of crushed tomatoes500g spaghetti1 tbsp oilMix the mince with some of the parmesan and the parsley. Roll into balls.Brown the meatballs in oil.Simmer the meatballs in the tomatoes for 40 minutes.Cook the spaghetti, toss with the sauce and more parmesan, and save a plate for the toys.College road trip chicken Caesar wrapsSo long, partner.How to make itAs written, serves 4Grilled garlic chicken, crisp cos, bacon bits and parmesan tossed in a creamy Caesar dressing, rolled in soft tortillas and wrapped tight for the drive.Toss 600g chicken thigh fillets with oil, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt, and grill for 5 minutes a side, then rest and slice.Fry 4 rashers of bacon until crisp and chop.Whisk 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 small grated garlic clove and 30g grated parmesan.Toss 1 shredded cos lettuce with the dressing, bacon and chicken.Fill 4 large tortillas, roll up tight and wrap in baking paper, then halve.SweetsStrawberry bear shortcakesWarm biscuits split and filled with sugared strawberries and creamHow to make it80g cold butter250g self-raising flour150ml milk400g strawberries, sliced2 tbsp caster sugar300ml thickened cream, whippedRub the butter into the flour, stir in the milk and pat out.Cut into rounds and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.Toss the strawberries with the sugar and stand for 15 minutes.Split the shortcakes and fill with whipped cream and the berries.Bonnie's tea party jam and cream sconesPlaytime with the toys in Bonnie's roomHow to make itAs written, serves 4Little buttermilk scones baked tall and golden, split warm and piled with strawberry jam and softly whipped cream for a pretend tea party.Heat the oven to 220°C.Rub 60g cold butter into 350g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar and a pinch of salt.Stir in 250ml buttermilk with a knife until it just comes together.Pat to 3cm thick, cut 12 small rounds with a floured cutter and pack close together on a lined tray.Brush with milk and bake for 12 minutes until risen and golden.Serve warm with strawberry jam and 200ml cream whipped soft.DrinksSunnyside strawberry malt shakesStrawberries, vanilla ice cream, milk and malt powder blended thick and pinkHow to make it300g ripe strawberries, 2 kept for garnish6 scoops of vanilla ice cream400ml cold milk3 tbsp malted milk powder1 tbsp honey4 tbsp whipped creamHull the strawberries and keep two for garnish.Blend the rest with the ice cream, milk, malt and honey until thick and pink.Pour into glasses and top with whipped cream and half a strawberry each.
